policy: One national dataset carries 2022-census-vintage community codes as spine columns. Community assignment is uniform over the harvested community distribution within each target-assigned marz; a geography-vintage mismatch is a compile error, and local use filters the national dataset rather than producing per-community files.

assignment_source.survey: ArmStat 2022 Population Census community distribution (exact table to harvest)
assignment_source.notes: Harvest the machine-readable population distribution and code roster for communities within each of the 10 marzes plus Yerevan. The post-amalgamation country has 71 consolidated communities; this package deliberately does not invent or hardcode their codes.

geography_spine.notes: One clone per record is the provisional compile-safe minimum, not an Armenian statistic. A larger collision-avoiding fanout cannot be set until the harvested 71-to-11 community roster proves the minimum within-marz support and an ex-ante policy is reviewed. The shared clone-and-assign implementation still lives in UK runtime modules; populace#263 must promote/bind it for Armenia. The target-derived marz constraint is preserved across every household clone.
